reproduction.layout: Fresh detached head and base Git clones beside these extracted scripts. Pin base refs to comparisonBase; preserve the publication remote and install matching pinned dependencies. Write selection.files to green-selection.json. For the baseline runner write files with recorded base samples to red-selection.json and an empty list to remaining-head.json; it runs both baseline rounds. Run each extracted runner through the recorded gate wrapper with the outer budget.

notes: The original mcp-defaults-verification.json audit remains a separate earlier record.
The deterministic deputy fixture identifier is assembled from parts for publication; its final test file, all 26 negative controls and types were rerun after that test-only edit.
Earlier quota-window timeouts recovered in the final whole-file run; case timeouts and expected values were unchanged.
The rotation fixture now creates and closes its own registry for each case, preserving every behavior assertion.

Relays from member agents through unbound owner conversations retain the existing policy. Account usage covers the installation; grouping by workspace belongs to slice (d). Global search_memory visibility is unchanged. Directive allow-lists continue to filter owner report replies, and directive catalog validation is unchanged.
